title: F-Q7: clientUri derived from leaf signature key (INVENTED)
description: INVENTED, NOT FROM SPEC. clientUri = mimi://<domain>/d/<base32(SHA-256(leaf signature key))>; stable because a mimi-mls Identity uses one signature key for all its KeyPackages. Add to wg mimid-1wgh.37.67. Approved by Mark 2026-10-18 (plan .7).
